statement: Five chained phases in order (GD; Polynomial; Bias-Variance; Regularization L1/L2/ENet; Logistic)
Each phase consumes previous phase artifact (hash chain + P1 weights as P2 init)
Each phase: Expectation before run / Outcome after / justification for every open choice
Team seed from sorted IDs; single seeded 80/20 split; one chronological split in P3
All fits (scaler/encoder/expansion/selection/thresholds) on train only; test only transformed
P1 GD from scratch; configurable lr; convergence behavior reported
P2 expansion fitted with own GD initialised from P1 weights; only worthwhile features expanded
P3 empirical bias-variance diagnosis + chronological comparison + trust argument + target complexity
P4 L1 L2 ENet implemented and compared fairly; lambda/l1_ratio search; per-column verdict with numbers
P5 derived non-trivial label; logistic on P4 survivors only; acc/F1/AUC on val; retrospective
Bonus: asymmetric 3x under-prediction loss in GD; gradient derived; prediction shift shown
Metrics: R2+RMSE on val for P1-P4; acc/F1/AUC for P5
Submission CSV from recommended regression model; instant order equals test.csv
Notebook top-to-bottom; report <= 6 pages; every member can explain and re-run
